sets.name: Authority and currentness
sets.rationale: Same frozen authority/currentness tasks can distinguish first-party lineage, rule-period auditing and origin-consistency methods.

sets.name: Verification and fail-open boundaries
sets.rationale: Matched reject/verification tasks test whether strategies catch false-green trust transitions without simply rejecting everything.

sets.name: Operational capability conjunctions
sets.rationale: These tasks require several implementation invariants to coexist and expose whether the claimed decision path reaches runtime truth.

sets.name: Ingestion and protocol durability
sets.rationale: Shared tasks compare source-history-run-truth reasoning with protocol/version defect archaeology.

sets.name: Agent lineage and governance
sets.rationale: Agent tasks reveal whether lineage/emergence methods find hardened descendants and whether acceptance tracing correctly bounds autonomy claims.
